name: Lance
source:
"As your fated, I have a duty to protect you."

Lance, a knight of the highest caliber, beloved by the citizens of Jerille. He comes from a noble background and carries himself with the dignity deserving of such a rank. While he is a knight, he is not against using any means necessary to accomplish his missions. His deceptive practices lead to a bad first impression, but will the warm, soothing meals that he makes you and the gentle words he whispers to you change your opinion of him?

This man bears your mark on his back, but what burdens does he carry on those broad shoulders? Who is the White Knight that everyone adores? And… just what is he so desperate to hide?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
